name: Kirkland Signature Boneless Skinless Chicken Breasts (Individually Wrapped)
whyItWorks: The gold-standard baseline protein for Crohn's and Colitis patients. Clean, unseasoned chicken breast contains virtually zero fat and zero fiber, making it the least inflammatory whole-food protein on earth.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Poach in salted water or bake covered with foil to keep it tender and moist. Shred over white rice or noodle broth.
